verdict.rationale: Porkbun's REST/JSON API can read all DNS records and retrieve SSL bundles, and a documented flow copies a domain's DNS records into the customer's own Cloudflare account and repoints nameservers, which amounts to a programmatic way to take DNS elsewhere. The evidence never documents a general data export or leaving the registrar entirely. Missing for 10: documented transfer-out/auth-code retrieval, bulk or zone-file (BIND) export, export of email/hosting/WordPress content, an account-wide data export, and independent corroboration.
